text: Hi, I'm writing about my offer for the MSc in Data Science. My name is Tadeusz Wrona-Bielecki and my applicant number is APP-60418377. text: Notes for my call with the loan servicer. Account holder: Thanh Tam Bui. Loan number LN-5520-8817, balance 14,250 pounds, 4.1 percent fixed.
